notes: The waw takes that as the connective the ASV wrote for its recast purpose clause (rules 14, 55); the competing reading marks the waw unrepresented and the that added, which rule 55 forbids where a conjunction stands in the clause.
The Hiphil infinitive הַעֲלֹת is headed on burn under rule 44's causative clause; heading on cause would be rule 24's disfavoured preference for the English light verb.
בְּנֵי takes the supplied the because the rectum is an anarthrous proper name (rule 29), and the assimilated article of לַמָּאוֹר is a real token taking the written the (rule 12).
